messages.subject: Re: How to test for significance of a group-specific negative residual variance in an MG-CFA?
parts:
I am struggling to identify how to constrain the model for the residual variance of x1 to be 0.  I attempted:
```
constraint <- '   ancestry ~~ c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, z11, NA, NA, NA) * ancestry '
z11 == 0
```

That doesn't work because you are mixing numerical values (fixing parameters, or freeing with NA) and labels (character strings).  
This would normally work:
constraint <- '   ancestry ~~ c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 0, NA, NA, NA) * ancestry '

But residual variances are not free parameters for ordinal data.
